text: Mr. Giovanelli sings splendidly. But I guess they’ll come before very long,” concluded Mrs. Miller hopefully. “I’m sorry she should come in that way,” said Mrs. Walker. “Well, I told her that there was no use in her getting dressed before dinner if she was going to wait three hours,” responded Daisy’s mamma. “I didn’t see the use of her putting on such a dress as that to sit round with Mr. Giovanelli.” “This is most horrible!” said Mrs. Walker, turning away and addressing herself to Winterbourne.
